verdict.rationale: The README explicitly shows a built-in web UI served by `llama serve` for chatting with a local model (Qwen), so a first-party graphical chat interface ships with the product. The evidence is only a brief caption plus the server command. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the web UI's chat features (history, settings, multimodal input), independent or hands-on community corroboration of the GUI (community reports cover only CLI chat).
